name: Bijou's Belongings
label: Quest
description: Bijou's Belongings: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Ordinarily I don't deal with travelers but it seems that I'm stuck between a troll and a hard place. You see, my mission here is one of utmost importance to the Horde. The information I've discovered, however, applies to the well being of the Alliance as well. Now believe me, I'm no Alliance sympathizer, but the Blackrock threat is bigger than just a bunch of orcs.
You help me out by finding my belongings and I'll help you out with some information that could prove useful to your kind.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Well I'll be! Where were they??
